threat_event: Attacker takes over a Project Manager mailbox (adversary-in-the-middle phishing) and redirects an owner's progress payment with forged remittance instructions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA is not phishing-resistant; no sign-in risk policy; no alerts on new inbox rules; owners were never told how the company changes bank details
existing_controls: Push MFA; email filtering; external-sender banner; cyber policy with $250,000 social engineering sublimit
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA (security keys or device-bound passkeys) for Project Managers, accounting, and executives; block legacy sign-in; alert on new forwarding and inbox rules; written remittance-change notice to every owner with a call-back procedure (P08)

threat_event: Fraudulent subcontractor or supplier bank-change request (spoofed or compromised vendor mailbox) diverts a subcontractor payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-master bank changes accepted by email and entered by one AP clerk; no call-back; no second approver; ACH batches need one approver
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 vendor master; SYS-09; BP-02 subcontractor payments
existing_controls: Positive pay on checks; dual approval for wires over $50,000
treatment_plan: Call-back to a phone number already on file for every bank change; second approver in the ERP vendor master; 10-day hold and pre-note on changed accounts; dual approval for ACH batches

threat_event: Attacker changes the company's EFT information in SAM so a federal progress payment goes to a mule account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Entity Administrator credentials reused elsewhere; no alert when SAM registration changes
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-13 SAM registration; BP-01 progress billing
treatment_plan: Unique credentials and security-key MFA for the SAM Entity Administrator; monthly check of SAM banking details against the bank; second person reviews any SAM update

threat_event: Owner pays a fake remittance request sent from a lookalike company domain
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No lookalike-domain monitoring; owners have no standing notice about remittance changes
existing_controls: External-sender banner at the company (does not protect owners)
treatment_plan: Register common lookalike domains; lookalike-domain monitoring service; remittance-change notice in every contract and on every pay app cover sheet

threat_event: Attacker spoofs the company's exact email domain to owners and subcontractors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DMARC at monitor-only (p=none)
treatment_plan: Move DMARC to quarantine then reject after reviewing reports

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the BIM/CAD file server and estimating database and deletes cloud backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups in the same account and region; never restore-tested; shared administrator roles
existing_controls: Daily backups; managed antivirus; MSP patching
treatment_plan: Immutable backups in a separate account and region; quarterly restore tests; separate backup administrator

threat_event: The company cannot achieve Final Level 1 (Self) CMMC status before the expected DoD award and loses eligibility
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No FCI scope, SSP, or self-assessment; 14 of 17 FAR requirement rows not fully met; no POA&Ms allowed at Level 1
treatment_plan: Close all Level 1 gaps; self-assess against SP 800-171A objectives; enter results and President's affirmation in SPRS before the solicitation closes

threat_event: An inaccurate CMMC affirmation or Section 889 representation exposes the company to False Claims Act liability
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SAM representations renewed without a documented reasonable inquiry; no evidence standard for affirmations
treatment_plan: Evidence binder for each affirmation and representation; counsel review before the President signs; annual re-check

threat_event: Covered video surveillance or telecommunications equipment is delivered on a federal project
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No submittal screening against the covered-entity list; private-label products hide the manufacturer
affected_asset_or_process: FC-1 and FC-2 installed systems; security systems group
treatment_plan: Section 889 screening step in submittal review (manufacturer and OEM confirmation); approved-manufacturer list; subcontract flowdown; replace FC-1 equipment

threat_event: Client facility security details (camera layouts, access control and building automation credentials) leak from the general file share
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Spreadsheets readable by all staff; commissioning laptops unencrypted
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05 file share; SYS-08 commissioning laptops; client facilities
treatment_plan: Move client credentials to a password vault with per-project access; restrict layout drawings to the project team; encrypt and manage commissioning laptops

threat_event: Federal bid documents uploaded to the AI bid assistant are retained or used to train the vendor's models
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standard vendor terms allow model improvement from customer data; no approved-tools list
treatment_plan: Pause federal uploads until an enterprise agreement with no-training and deletion terms is signed; approved-tools list (see P10)

threat_event: AI bid assistant produces wrong quantities or prices that go into a fixed-price bid
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No output accuracy testing; takeoffs not always checked against drawings
treatment_plan: Mandatory estimator verification of AI takeoffs by trade; accuracy testing against 10 past bids (see P10)

threat_event: AI-assisted estimates submitted as certified cost or pricing data are not accurate, complete, and current
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No record of which figures came from the AI tool
treatment_plan: Keep source records for every AI-derived figure used in federal pricing; human sign-off

threat_event: A shared AI pricing model pools the company's pricing with competitors' data, putting its independent price determination at risk
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor terms unclear on cross-customer data use
treatment_plan: Contract terms: no cross-customer pricing features; counsel review (see P10)

threat_event: A former field employee still reaches email and project drawings after leaving
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field accounts disabled up to 10 business days after termination; high craft and field turnover
treatment_plan: Same-day disable from the HR termination ticket; weekly reconciliation of HR and identity provider lists

threat_event: A stale subcontractor account in the project management platform is used to download drawings for other federal projects
threat_source: Former business partner or account thief
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 212 external accounts never removed at project closeout
existing_controls: External users limited to their project
treatment_plan: Remove external users at closeout; quarterly external user review

threat_event: Password spraying compromises a shared jobsite trailer account that has no MFA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 shared accounts exempt from MFA; shared passwords
treatment_plan: Replace shared accounts with named accounts and MFA; shared mailbox access by delegation

threat_event: A lost or stolen rugged tablet exposes cached federal drawings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 20 tablets not in device management; no remote wipe; no screen-lock policy
existing_controls: Tablets stored in trailers at night
treatment_plan: Enroll tablets in device management with passcode, encryption, and remote wipe

threat_event: Theft from a jobsite trailer (laptop, plan sets) or unescorted visitor access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No visitor log; keys and yard gate combination never inventoried or changed
treatment_plan: Visitor sign-in at every trailer; key inventory; change the gate combination and rekey trailers at staff changes

threat_event: Attacker exploits the internet-facing file-transfer portal and pivots to the internal BIM/CAD file server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal in the same subnet as internal servers; no vulnerability scanning
existing_controls: Cloud network rules limit inbound ports
treatment_plan: Move the portal to its own public subnet with deny-by-default rules to internal servers; monthly vulnerability scans

threat_event: Unpatched main office firewall firmware is exploited for remote access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firmware 14 months old; no vulnerability scanning
existing_controls: No management interface exposed to the internet
treatment_plan: Quarterly firmware updates by the MSP; monthly vulnerability scans

threat_event: A retired laptop or phone that was not sanitized exposes FCI or employee data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Devices wiped informally or given to employees; no records
treatment_plan: Documented wipe or certified destruction with a record for every device

threat_event: Certified payroll files with full Social Security numbers are exposed from a compromised mailbox
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Subcontractors email full payroll records to the payroll mailbox; no encryption requirement
treatment_plan: Subcontractors upload payroll records to SYS-01 instead of email; auto-delete payroll attachments from mailboxes after upload

threat_event: Account takeover in the payroll system redirects an employee's direct deposit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Employees can change bank details in self-service with no notification
treatment_plan: Notify employees of any bank change; 3-day hold on changed deposit accounts

threat_event: Project management platform outage during pay app week or a bid deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency; no independent export of project records
treatment_plan: Weekly export of current drawings and pay app packages to the cloud file server

threat_event: Hurricane closes the main office and jobsites for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No contingency plan; single internet circuit at the main office
existing_controls: SaaS systems reachable from anywhere; jobsite hurricane plans for physical work
treatment_plan: IT contingency plan with remote-work procedures and cellular failover

threat_event: Staff do not recognize or report an incident, so containment and notice clocks are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident response plan; no reporting channel; training is minimal
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171; N23-R03 (252.204-7012(c) if CDI is ever held)
treatment_plan: Adopt POL-03 and the P08 runbook; reporting line on badges and trailer posters; include in training

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP remote management tool gives attackers access to all managed endpoints
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MSP security review; MSP tool access not restricted by source
treatment_plan: Require MFA and source restrictions on MSP tooling; annual MSP security review with a SOC 2 report or questionnaire

threat_event: The company website posts non-public details of a federal facility
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No review before posting project photos
existing_controls: Photos of the FC-2 security room removed 2026-07-20
treatment_plan: Named approvers and a pre-posting checklist; quarterly website review

threat_event: Telematics account compromise reveals equipment locations and enables equipment theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared telematics login
treatment_plan: Accepted by the IT Manager: residual risk Low; named accounts with MFA to be required at the 2027 telematics contract renewal

threat_event: Client security systems are commissioned with default or shared administrator passwords
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No commissioning hardening checklist
affected_asset_or_process: Client-installed video surveillance, access control, building automation
regulatory_driver: N23-R02 (52.204-25) for federal installs; client contracts
treatment_plan: Commissioning checklist: unique admin credentials, firmware current, default accounts disabled; handover of credentials to the client in the vault

threat_event: Malware on an unmanaged commissioning laptop spreads to a client's building systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 shared commissioning laptops unmanaged and unencrypted
treatment_plan: Enroll in device management; encryption; named logins

threat_event: CUI-marked drawings arrive on a DoD project and are stored in systems that do not meet NIST SP 800-171
threat_source: Government or design firm (data handling error)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No intake check for CUI markings
treatment_plan: CUI marking check at document intake; return or quarantine procedure and Contracting Officer contact

threat_event: A single AP user (or a compromised AP account) releases a fraudulent ACH batch
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ACH batches need only one approver
treatment_plan: Dual approval for all ACH batches in the bank portal; separate initiator and approver
